record.title: Ban Khao Din–Sampov Loun January2017 trader blockade of international crossing
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.endpoint_type: reported same-day dispersal and restoration of passage
record.scope: Ban Khao Din–Sampov Loun international bridge/crossing obstructed by Cambodian vendors
record.crossings: Ban Khao Din, Khlong Hat, Sa Kaeo / Sampov Loun, Battambang
record.direction: Obstruction of cross-border movement; vendors sought access from Cambodia to collect goods in Thailand.
record.movement: People and goods attempting passage at the bridge/crossing; precise traffic counts unverified.
record.exceptions: No blockade exemptions established. Ordinary Thai and Cambodian gate opening is reported before the obstruction.
record.imposing_authority: Cambodian vendors acting as non-state protesters
record.enforcement: Reported physical obstruction by vendors followed by negotiated dispersal.
record.consequences: Temporary passage disruption; no independently measured volume or loss.
record.relationship: Promotes R12-AS-L001. Distinct from R12-AS-001 October15 2017 blockade and2017Poipet vendor episodes.
record.status_observation: Historical event only; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Traders sought earlier access to collect fresh goods for sale in Cambodia.
record.context: Deliberate protest obstruction after normal gate opening; eligibility concerns blockade, not ordinary opening hours.
record.uncertainty: Accounts share named sources and are not treated as independent confirmations. Crowd estimates differ and are omitted. Around06:00 onset and around08:00 dispersal are reported clock times, not a measured duration. Temporary trading accommodation is not proof of a lasting hours policy.
